guide.title: Where the World's Wounds Open Outward
guide.description: A continuous history of the Fourth War, N’Zoth, the Shadowlands, Dragon Isles, Khaz Algar, K’aresh, and the released Midnight crisis through the Coiled Isle.

nodes.title: The wounded inherit another war
nodes.narration: Victory over the Legion did not quiet the world. Alliance and Horde entered a new war across distant footholds, carrying grief, fear, and old distrust into regions that possessed their own histories. The conflict spread beyond any single battlefield. Peoples who had endured the same invasion now turned their strength against one another, while the wounds of the last war still lay open.

nodes.title: A people turns against its warchief
nodes.narration: Within the Horde, loyalty to community and obedience to Sylvanas no longer led along the same road. Rebellion gathered, and Alliance pressure converged with it against her rule. The war campaign ended, but its dead did not return and its broken trust did not mend at a command. The fighting could be brought to an end; the losses would remain with those who survived it.

nodes.title: The last prison opens beneath the wounds
nodes.narration: N'Zoth emerged into a world already strained by war. Assaults struck more than fortifications; they pressed upon perception, memory, and will. The nightmare of Ny'alotha reached into the struggle, turning the mind itself into contested ground. Against this ancient enemy, strength of arms alone offered little shelter from the fear that even one's own senses could betray.

nodes.title: The nightmare is entered and broken
nodes.narration: To end the assault, champions carried the struggle into Ny'alotha and confronted N'Zoth within the nightmare. There, the Old God's immediate campaign was defeated. Yet the relief was brief: the world had scarcely turned from those visions when another boundary, the veil between life and death, was violently opened.

nodes.title: The sky above Icecrown is torn
nodes.narration: Sylvanas shattered the veil above Icecrown, opening the way into the realms of death. Beyond it lay the Shadowlands, where mortal life gave way to another order of existence. Distinct realms held their own duties and powers, and the crisis drawing Azeroth's champions across that threshold reached beyond the fate of any living kingdom.

nodes.title: Four realms keep their separate callings
nodes.narration: Within the Shadowlands, four covenants kept their separate callings. Each carried its own duty, memory, and crisis. Mortal champions moved among their campaigns, encountering powers whose purposes had been shaped far from the struggles of Azeroth. Yet the danger reached through the order of death itself, and those distinct realms found reasons to resist it together.

nodes.title: The ancient isles awaken to a changed world
nodes.narration: After the journey beyond death, the Dragon Isles awakened and called the dragonflights home. Their return reopened questions of inheritance, purpose, and the meaning of guardianship. Azeroth's oldest powers had endured betrayal, loss, and change. Now the flights turned again toward their ancient homeland, carrying all that history into the task of finding their place in a changed world.

nodes.title: The warning descends beneath Khaz Algar
nodes.narration: In Khaz Algar, the lands beneath the surface drew Azeroth into another struggle. Xal'atath gathered her designs while the Earthen revealed cultures shaped beyond the familiar kingdoms. After wars that had crossed oceans, stars, and the veil of death, the road now led into the depths of the world itself, where older inheritances met a gathering threat.

nodes.title: Beyond Azeroth, a shattered world
nodes.narration: The pursuit carried the defenders beyond Azeroth to K’aresh, a world already broken by the Void. There, a struggle over the Dark Heart threatened to restore an ancient devourer. The survivors fought to keep what remained of their home, while Azeroth’s champions confronted the danger alongside them. The crisis did not remain a distant tale: its shadow reached back toward Silvermoon.

nodes.title: The first shadow over Quel’Thalas
nodes.narration: The road from Khaz Algar and shattered K’aresh led back to Quel’Thalas. Xal’atath and the Devouring Host descended upon the Sunwell, and the defenders of Silvermoon gathered to preserve their home. Their first stand forced the invaders back, but only for a time. In Eversong, a strange Lightbloom spread, and the land itself bore witness that the danger had not passed.

nodes.title: The Sunwell falls into shadow
nodes.narration: The reprieve ended at the Voidspire. Xal’atath turned the Sunwell’s light against itself, and the sacred fount became the Darkwell. Two defenders vanished into its depths; their final fate was not known. For the people of Quel’Thalas, this was more than the loss of a stronghold. A place bound to their survival had become the heart of the invading darkness.

nodes.title: A new light from old wounds
nodes.narration: In answer, the elven peoples came together across divisions long held apart. They drove the Devouring Host from the corrupted fount. Sylvanas returned to stand beside her kin, and Xal’atath was forced to retreat. Each people brought part of its inheritance to cleanse the well. From the Darkwell arose the Dawnwell: a new light made by those who chose to defend a shared future.

nodes.title: The curse beyond Zul’Aman
nodes.narration: Yet the age did not close at the Dawnwell. East of Zul’Aman, the Coiled Isle drew the campaign onward. A division within the Amani family led toward an older danger, and an ancient venomous power was unleashed. Champions entered the Venomous Abyss to face it. This archive reaches that released chapter, while the wider Worldsoul Saga remains unfinished.
